Name: Kwame Obiora

Work Experience:
- 2023--2023: Electrical Engineering Intern, Lagos Power Solutions. Assisted in the design and testing of power distribution systems for commercial clients. Collaborated with senior engineers to optimize circuit layouts and improve energy efficiency. Conducted site inspections to ensure compliance with safety standards and regulatory requirements. Developed technical reports summarizing findings from fieldwork and laboratory analysis. Supported the integration of renewable energy sources, such as solar panels, into existing electrical infrastructure.
- 2022--2022: Research Intern, Smart Grid Technologies, University of Ghana Energy Research Lab. Participated in research projects focused on the implementation of smart grid technologies in urban areas. Collected and analyzed data on electricity consumption patterns using advanced metering infrastructure
